description: This file defines a configuration class for the Starboard Android Cobalt environment, including test filters, environment variables, and handling of test exclusions.

classes.name: CobaltAndroidConfiguration
classes.description: A configuration class for Starboard Android Cobalt, extending the base CobaltConfiguration with Android-specific test filters and environment variables.

methods.name: GetTestFilters
methods.description: Extends base test filters with additional Android-specific test filters.

methods.name: GetTestEnvVariables
methods.description: Returns environment variables for different test suites, disabling leak detection.

methods.name: GetWebPlatformTestFilters
methods.description: Adds specific web platform test filters, including security policy and websocket tests.
